newsitem.title: USA: Safety-Kleen sees $10 mln in Lab Pack revs.
newsitem.headline: Safety-Kleen sees $10 mln in Lab Pack revs.

text.p: Safety-Kleen Corp said Thursday it expects its new Lab Pack Services business to post about $10 million in revenues in 1997.
It also said it recently completed a second acquisition in that market.

"We have made two small but strategic acquisitions in this industry which will help us to gain an immediate share of the market," Safety-Kleen president and chief executive John Johnson said in a statement from the company's annual shareholder meeting.

The company said it has 20 Lab Pack teams with trained chemists who identify classes of waste, pack materials and arrange for disposal. Safety-Kleen said it can collect most types of hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
Safety-Kleen estimates the overall Lab Pack market at $400 million.

Safety-Kleen said the price of lube oil continues to fall, including another decline of $0.03 per gallon reported last week. Safety-Kleen collects used oil and refines it for sale as base lube stock oil.
"We continue to focus on reducing costs and increasing collection fees for used oil we collect in an attempt to mitigate the negative impact," Johnson said.
Shares of Safety-Kleen, an environmental and industrial service company, traded up 1/8 at 15-5/8.
